image_description: A close-up view of a metallic breastplate armor piece against a white background. The armor features a segmented, muscular design on the lower half (resembling abs) and a smooth, curved upper chest plate. It has a gunmetal grey finish with soft specular highlights indicating a polished metal surface. Black attachment points or straps are visible on the sides.

artifact_observations.reasoning: The 'abs' segments have a slightly soft, rubbery appearance rather than rigid metal. The transitions between segments lack the sharp, hard edges expected of steel plating, suggesting slight AI smoothing or melting.

The black attachment hardware on the left and right sides appears somewhat indistinct and fused into the main body. The geometry of the buckles/straps is not mechanically clear, looking more like painted blobs than functional 3D objects.

To verify the continuity of the metal plates and ensure the 'muscle' segments are physically connected and not floating.
